verdicts_or_reports.expected: The secondary caption should match the shared caption used on the Medicines list and Medicine details for the same medicine: "Tablet · 3 mg".
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Same medicine shows "Oral · 3 mg" on the Plan today card (and on the Home today card) but "Tablet · 3 mg" on the Medicines list card and Medicine details card. The Plan card also shows an "Oral" badge, so the caption repeats the route and omits the form.
steps: Create a Group 1 with Estradiol valerate tablet 3 mg at 7:30 AM.
On the Plan tab, look at the today (Nov 14 SAT) medication card: caption reads "Oral · 3 mg".
Open Medicines (top-right) and the medicine details: the same medicine's card caption reads "Tablet · 3 mg".
On Medicine details, the Active group chip for the same medicine also reads "Estradiol valerate · Oral · 3 mg" while the medicine card above it reads "Tablet · 3 mg".

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Medicine details → Edit medicine bottom sheet
verdicts_or_reports.element: Save button in Edit medicine sheet
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Tapping Save with an empty tablet strength should show a validation message (as the Add medicine flow does: "Enter a valid tablet strength.") and keep the sheet open.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: With the Tablet strength field empty, tapping Save does nothing at all and no validation message appears; the sheet just stays as-is with no feedback.
steps: Open Medicines and tap the Estradiol valerate card.
Tap Edit medicine (pencil) to open the Edit medicine bottom sheet.
Hide the keyboard and tap Save.
Nothing happens: no error message is shown, the sheet stays open; re-tapping Save also does nothing. (Entering a value such as 3 and tapping Save works.)

verdicts_or_reports.element: Estradiol estimate card (value unit and target pill)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After choosing pmol/L for Estradiol in Settings, the Home estimate card should display Estradiol and its target range in pmol/L (consistent with the Calibration screen, which shows 367–734 pmol/L).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Home still shows the Estradiol value unit as "pg/mL" and the target pill as "Target 100–200 pg/mL", even after leaving and returning to Home; the Calibration screen already shows the converted target "Estradiol: 367–734 pmol/L".
steps: Tap Calibration settings and select pmol/L for Estradiol (the Calibration screen then shows target 367–734 pmol/L).
Return to Settings via Cancel, then open Home.
Home still shows "pg/mL" and "Target 100–200 pg/mL"; switching to Plan and back to Home does not update it.
